The Senior FDE Lead will be the **embedded client\-facing technical builder** who converts Model Office and design decisions rapidly into working configurations, AI workflows, prototypes and demonstrations.
  

This person needs the unusual combination of **software/AI engineering ability, solution architecture, rapid prototyping and client presence**.
  

The FDE Lead should be comfortable sitting in a client design session, understanding a requirement, translating it into a technical approach, building or configuring it rapidly, testing it with users, learning from the results and iterating in near\-real time.
  

This is emphatically **not a traditional project manager or solution architect who hands requirements to an offshore development team.** The person must be able to build.

* Translate Model Office decisions into working sandbox configurations and prototypes.
* Develop and configure AI\-enabled workflows and agents.
* Write code where required to integrate, prototype or extend platform capabilities.

* Test AI outputs and workflow behavior against expected outcomes.
* Build evaluation approaches and use results to improve prompts, models, agents and workflow logic.
* Work with business/clinical users to gather feedback and iterate rapidly.

jobs.description:
**What We Do**


At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets. Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem\-solvers, building solutions in Artificial Intelligence, risk management, big data, mobile and more.


We are seeking entrepreneurial **Agentic Software Engineers** to join a newly formed **AI Agentic Systems** team. This team is tasked with solving firmwide, large\-scale compute infrastructure challenges by architecting and deploying autonomous "swarms" of agents. These agents will interface seamlessly with human teams, and complex digital substrates to optimize, analyze, and manage our global technology footprint.


As a founding member of this team, you will help incubate a new paradigm of software engineering—moving beyond static automation to dynamic, goal\-oriented agentic systems that operate across the totality of the firm’s business units.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Agentic Orchestration: Design and deploy multi\-agent systems (swarms) capable of autonomous planning, reasoning, and execution across distributed cloud environments.
* System Integration: Build robust interfaces between AI agents, and human stakeholders to ensure high\-fidelity feedback loops and operational transparency.
* Infrastructure at Scale: Develop agentic solutions for complex compute infrastructure problems, including real\-time observability, predictive optimization, and automated capacity planning.
* Substrate Development: Contribute to the "agentic substrate"—the underlying platform and tooling that allows agents to securely access data, execute code, and interact with firmwide APIs.
* Cross\-Functional Incubation: Partner with diverse business units to identify high\-impact use cases for agents, translating ambiguous business needs into technical agentic workflows.

**Required Qualifications**


* Software Engineering Excellence: Strong proficiency in Python, Go, or C\+\+ with a deep understanding of distributed systems and cloud\-native architecture (AWS, Azure, or internal private clouds).
* Agentic Experience: Direct experience deploying LLM\-based agents in production environments. Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGPT, or custom\-built orchestration layers.
* Problem\-Solving Domains: Proven track record of applying agentic patterns to at least two of the following:


	+ Data Analysis: Autonomous synthesis of large\-scale datasets.
	+ Observability: Self\-healing infrastructure and automated root\-cause analysis.
	+ Optimization: Dynamic resource allocation and cost management.
	+ Planning: Multi\-step task decomposition and execution in non\-deterministic environments.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Ability to thrive in a 0\-to\-1 environment, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven to build systems that have never existed before.

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience with Digital Twin technology and its integration with real\-time telemetry.
* Knowledge of Multi\-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) or swarm intelligence principles.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other emerging standards for agent\-to\-tool communication.
* Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical agentic logic and human\-centric business processes.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – ServiceNow AI (ITRF)
jobs.description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


**Job Purpose**

Welcome to ZEISS \- a company that combines innovation and responsibility!


You will contribute to ZEISS digital transformation by bringing people, processes, and data together on one reliable and easy\-to\-use enterprise platform. The ServiceNow teams operate and develop Enterprise Service Management and custom applications used globally.


This is not a role for maintaining yesterday's workflows. As ServiceNow AI Developer, you will help build the next generation of intelligent IT Request Fulfillment at global scale. You will turn Now Assist, Now Assist for Creator, GenAI, AI Agents, and intelligent automation into production\-ready capabilities that transform how requests are designed, tested, fulfilled, and continuously improved. Your work will directly shape how the ITRF team enters the agentic era.


**Your Mission and role**

* Identify and prioritize practical AI use cases, build prototypes, validate value and risk and convert successful concepts into secure, maintainable production solutions.
* Translate business requirements into smart, scalable technical solutions
* Use ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist, Now Assist for Creator, GenAI, Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, AI\-powered workflows and AI Agents to improve request creation, fulfillment, support, consulting and user experience.
* Use AI\-assisted development to increase delivery efficiency, improve code and documentation quality, strengthen testing, and reduce unnecessary customization.
* Develop reusable prompts, skills, patterns, components, subflows, actions, APIs and guidance for AI\-enabled catalog and fulfillment solutions.
* Coach and advise the ITRF team on ServiceNow AI capabilities, prompt engineering, responsible use, limitations, quality controls and best practices.
* Support the team in leveraging AI capabilities to reduce customizations and move towards Out\-of\-the\-Box (OOTB) best practices, improving delivery practices, documentations and operational processes.
* Be the hands\-on AI champion who drives initiatives from idea to production within end\-to\-end workflows in collaboration with Product Owners, architects, developers, testers, process owners, security and platform stakeholders.
* Review AI\-generated output critically for correctness, security, maintainability and hallucinations before it is used in production.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with platform standards, security, privacy, ZEISS governance and ethical AI requirements
* Define measurable outcomes and continuously optimize AI\-enabled solutions for adoption, automation rate, engineering quality, user experience and delivery speed.

**Your Technology Playground**

* IT Request Fulfillment: Service Catalog, Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Requests, Requested Items, Catalog Tasks, approvals, fulfillment orchestration and Employee Center Pro.
* AI enablement: Now Assist, Now Assist for Creator, GenAI, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, prompt engineering, evaluation and human review.
* Platform development: JavaScript, Glide APIs, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, events and scoped applications.
* Quality engineering: Automated Test Framework (ATF), test generation and maintenance, debugging, code review, technical documentation, monitoring and continuous improvement.

**What You Bring**

* 3\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow development experience with strong JavaScript, Glide API, Flow Designer, integration, debugging and solution engineering skills.
* Practical experience implementing ServiceNow AI or intelligent automation capabilities, preferably Now Assist, Now Assist for Creator, Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence and in best case AI Agents.
* Solid experience with Service Catalog and IT Request Fulfillment, including request lifecycle, approvals, fulfillment flows, and Employee Center or Service Portal.
* Ability to design, build, test, secure, document and operate production\-grade AI\-enabled ServiceNow solutions rather than prototypes only.
* Working knowledge of prompt engineering, grounding, output evaluation, hallucination control, data quality, privacy, security and responsible AI practices.
* Hands\-on experience with ATF and automated quality controls for ServiceNow configurations, flows, catalog solutions and custom development.
* Ability to identify high\-value automation opportunities, challenge existing solutions and translate business needs into scalable, standard\-oriented technical implementations.
* Strong coaching and communication skills with the ability to enable developers, testers, architects and Product Owners in a global team.
* Professional English and a builder mindset: curious, pragmatic, ownership\-driven, comfortable experimenting and determined to turn emerging technology into reliable business value.

**Education \& Work Experience**

* Completed degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science or an equivalent qualification.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) are preferred; relevant ServiceNow AI, implementation, or micro\-certifications are advantageous.
* ITIL Foundation and practical experience in Agile/Scrum/DevOps delivery are advantageous.
* Extensive professional experience as a Application Specialist, Business Analyst or comparable role in a global enterprise env

**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**


Experience: 3\-5 Years

**About the Company:**


Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production\-grade AI agents end\-to\-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

 **The Role**


We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end\-to\-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End\-to\-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool\-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration \& Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability \& Root\-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root\-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation \& Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live\-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (3\-5\) years of software development experience, with at least 2\+ years of hands\-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud \& Web Architecture: Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication \& Presence: Strong client\-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on\-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real\-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**


Experience: 3\-5 Years

**About the Company:**


Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production\-grade AI agents end\-to\-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

 **The Role**


We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end\-to\-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End\-to\-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool\-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration \& Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability \& Root\-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root\-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation \& Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live\-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (3\-5\) years of software development experience, with at least 2\+ years of hands\-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud \& Web Architecture: Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication \& Presence: Strong client\-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on\-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real\-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems
